evidence.note: Iterative debugging of chain recompute and cycle detection, with precise reconciliation against the dev suite ('76 passing', then '129/131 passing! Two failures:' naming each). Tracks done-vs-remaining against verification results, not just self-report.

Detects a stalled subsystem: notices the 100k import hanging, diagnoses quadratic behavior, localizes the O(N^2) hotspot in transitive_dependents_with_cycles, fixes it (197s->1s), and re-verifies. Detection of a stuck state with deliberate effort reallocation, no looping.

Recurring enumerated lists of outstanding hidden-suite areas (CF export, DV export, pivot cols, spill # syntax, XLSX cached values), addressed one-by-one with a full-suite re-run after each. Shows rolling tracking of remaining surface, though re-derived each time rather than a single maintained ledger.

Catches that funcs.py wasn't imported by workbook.py and correctly reasons why tests still passed (server imports it), rather than looping in confusion — accurate state tracking of a subtle wiring issue.

The ~150-function catalog is built in a single systematic burst by category (math/stats/text/logical/lookup/date/dynamic-array/financial/etc.) but never subsequently checked off in a done/partial/not-started ledger; later coverage is spot-checked ad hoc — the main gap below the level-8 anchor.

reasoning: The agent maintains granular, continuously verification-reconciled awareness of done-vs-remaining (exact pass counts after nearly every change) and demonstrably detects a stalled performance subsystem, diagnosing and fixing it without circular thrashing — clearly beyond the 'simple checklist' of anchor 5. It falls short of anchor 8's 'live, granular ledger of the function catalog and endpoint families' because tracking is prose-based and re-derived (recurring brainstorm lists) rather than a sustained single-source ledger, and the large function catalog is built once and only spot-checked. This places it at a 7, between the 5 and 8 anchors.
